title: Review pi-search architecture against current OpenAI/Codex search
description: Audit extension architecture, current OpenAI Responses web search, and official Codex search implementation; report concrete defects and prioritized SOTA improvements.

logs.msg: Review findings: architecture is strong on provider-neutral contracts, explicit auth, strict routing, bounded SSRF-safe fetch, and evidence fencing. Concrete defects: src/openai.ts active wrong-api guard blocks registry-selected compatible model; src/research-tool.ts only fetches when stopReason=completed, so provider-call/cost budgets and partial provider failures suppress valid local fetches; src/search-tool.ts conflates internal deadline abort with caller cancellation; src/openai.ts accepts bare JSON arrays as completed Responses. Current official Codex source uses POST alpha/search with SearchRequest/commands/settings and non-stream JSON, so current openai-codex adapter needs live validation or separate adapter. Current OpenAI docs expose search_context_size, return_token_budget, external_web_access, user_location, search_content_types/image settings, which are absent.
